   264	/-- For a scalar-linear outcome, its actual readout equals the two specialized
   265	coefficient polynomials in the corresponding block and scalar order. This is
   266	an exact identity, with no field-size condition; support for `eq:qld-g-48`

   268	theorem scalarPolynomial_linear_read_fiber (P : AdmissibleParams)
   269	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   270	    (hg : ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),
   271	      scalarPolynomial P g = MvPolynomial.C r * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   272	        MvPolynomial.C t * MvPolynomial.X 1)
   273	    (reverse : Bool) (x z : Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) (v : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P) :
   274	    extendedPolynomialRead P (fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v)) g =
   275	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   276	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 1 else 0) 1)
   277	          reverse)) +
   278	      v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z)
   279	        (blockCoefficientPolynomial P g (Finsupp.single (if reverse then 0 else 1) 1)
   280	          reverse)) := by
   281	  obtain ⟨r, t, hg⟩ := hg
   282	  let u : Fin (2 * P.m) → PauliScalar P := fun i => Sum.elim x z
   283	    (((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   284	      (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)) i)
   285	  let v' : Fin 2 → PauliScalar P := if reverse then ![v 1, v 0] else v
   286	  have heq : scalarBaseQuestionEquiv P (u, v') =
   287	      fiberQuestionEquiv P reverse ((z, x), v) := by
   288	    cases reverse <;> simp [scalarBaseQuestionEquiv, fiberQuestionEquiv, u, v',

   290	  rw [← heq, ← scalarPolynomial_eval, hg]
   291	  simp_rw [blockCoefficientPolynomial_eval, hg]
   292	  have h01 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := by

   294	    simpa using congrArg (fun e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => e 0) h
   295	  simp only [map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_C, MvPolynomial.map_X,
   296	    MvPolynomial.eval_C, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
   297	  cases reverse <;>
   298	    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, MvPolynomial.coeff_add,
   299	      MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, h01, Ne.symm h01,
   300	      ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
   301	  · change MvPolynomial.eval u r * v 0 + MvPolynomial.eval u t * v 1 =
   302	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval u r + v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval u t
   303	    ring
   304	  · change MvPolynomial.eval u r * v 1 + MvPolynomial.eval u t * v 0 =
   305	      v 0 * MvPolynomial.eval u t + v 1 * MvPolynomial.eval u r
   306	    ring

   309	    (p : MvPolynomial B F) :
   310	    MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv F A B (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr p) =
   311	      MvPolynomial.C p := by
   312	  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
   313	  | C r => simp

   317	private theorem blockCoefficientPolynomial_const {P : AdmissibleParams}
   318	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd) (a : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (reverse : Bool)
   319	    (h : ∃ r, blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse = MvPolynomial.C r) :
   320	    ∃ r : Poly P, (scalarPolynomial P g).coeff a = MvPolynomial.rename
   321	      (fun i => ((baseCoordinateEquiv P.m).trans
   322	        (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _)).symm (.inr i)) r.1 := by
   323	  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h
   324	  have hmem : r ∈ Preliminaries.polyFunc P.m (PauliScalar P) P.d := by
   325	    apply mem_polyFunc_of_degreeOf_le
   326	    intro i
   327	    apply MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff.mpr
   328	    intro b hb
   329	    have hcoeff :
   330	        ((blockCoefficientPolynomial P g a reverse).coeff 0).coeff b ≠ 0 := by
   331	      simpa only [hr, MvPolynomial.coeff_C, ↓reduceIte] using MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hb
   332	    have hsupport : Finsupp.sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp.symm (0, b) ∈

   334	          (if reverse then Equiv.sumComm _ _ else Equiv.refl _))

   339	  refine ⟨⟨r, hmem⟩, ?_⟩

   342	  apply MvPolynomial.rename_injective eqv eqv.injective

   345	  rw [hr, MvPolynomial.rename_rename]

   350	    MvPolynomial.sumRingEquiv _ _ _ (MvPolynomial.rename
   351	      (eqv ∘ (fun i => eqv.symm (.inr i))) r)
   352	  rw [heq, sumRingEquiv_rename_inr]

   382	outcome in the existing bounded `combinePoly` image. The two components have

   384	This identifies the separated image in `eq:qld-g-non-separable` with
   385	`def:combine-map`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   386	theorem exists_polyPair_of_scalar_separated (P : AdmissibleParams)
   387	    (g : DirectPolyTuple P.extendedDirectLd)
   388	    (hlin : ∃ r t : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * P.m)) (PauliScalar P),

     5	/-!
     6	# Indicator-weighted ordered projectors
     7	
     8	This module proves the local norm calculation in `eq:qld-g-prime`. The state
     9	vector is not assumed normalized: its squared norm controls the exceptional
    10	coefficient, so the estimate can be summed over all polynomial outcomes.
    11	The measurements act on an arbitrary finite space, which includes either
    12	player's placed expanded measurements.
    13	
    14	The coefficient-polynomial argument also bounds mass outside the scalar-linear
    15	image, with its actual ordered-correlation error displayed in the conclusion.
    16	These are auxiliary estimates, not the global polynomial-pair construction.
    17	The remaining block-separation and construction obligations are recorded in
    18	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex` and issue #513.
    19	
    20	Only the dependency chain needed for these estimates is exposed; supporting
    21	lemmas remain private.
    22	
    23	## References
    24	
    25	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1289-1326`,
    26	  especially `eq:qld-g-42`, `eq:qld-g-43`, and `eq:qld-g-prime`.
    27	-/

    29	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder

    40	variable {F ι : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]

    42	
    43	/-- The ordered product selected by the linear field-answer check in
    44	`eq:qld-g-42`. This is an operator, not an asserted measurement effect. -/
    45	def orderedIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    46	  ∑ bc : F × F, if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    47	
    48	/-- The diagonal sandwich sum in `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
    49	def diagonalIndicator (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α β a : F) : Op ι :=
    50	  ∑ bc : F × F,
    51	    if α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a then
    52	      Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 else 0
    53	
    54	/-- For a nonzero second coefficient, X orthogonality and cancellation in
    55	the field eliminate every off-diagonal term of the ordered Gram operator.
    56	This is the exact local algebra behind `eq:qld-g-prime`; no commutation of
    57	the X and Z measurements is assumed. -/
    58	private theorem orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    59	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    60	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a =
    61	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a := by
    62	  classical
    63	  unfold orderedIndicator diagonalIndicator
    64	  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    65	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun bc _ => ?_
    66	  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single bc]
    67	  · by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    68	    · simp only [if_pos h, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, measurement_effect_hermitian]
    69	      rw [mul_assoc (Z.effect bc.2), ← mul_assoc (X.effect bc.1),
    70	        (hX bc.1).isIdempotentElem.eq, ← mul_assoc]
    71	    · simp [h]
    72	  · intro bc' _ hne
    73	    by_cases h : α * bc.1 + β * bc.2 = a
    74	    · by_cases h' : α * bc'.1 + β * bc'.2 = a
    75	      · have hb : bc.1 ≠ bc'.1 := by
    76	          intro hb
    77	          have hc : bc.2 = bc'.2 := mul_left_cancel₀ hβ (by
    78	            apply add_left_cancel (a := α * bc.1)
    79	            simpa only [hb] using h.trans h'.symm)
    80	          exact hne (Prod.ext hb hc).symm
    81	        simp only [if_pos h, if_pos h', Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,
    82	          measurement_effect_hermitian]
    83	        calc
    84	          Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * (X.effect bc'.1 * Z.effect bc'.2) =
    85	              Z.effect bc.2 * (X.effect bc.1 * X.effect bc'.1) * Z.effect bc'.2 := by
    86	            simp only [mul_assoc]
    87	          _ = 0 := by rw [projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero X hX hb]; simp
    88	      · simp [h']
    89	    · simp [h]
    90	  · simp

    92	/-- The squared state norm of the ordered indicator equals its diagonal
    93	sandwich quadratic form when the second coefficient is nonzero. -/
    94	private theorem orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
    95	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (α β a : F) (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    96	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    97	    ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 =
    98	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) := by
    99	  rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq,
   100	    orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   101	  rfl

   103	/-- The diagonal indicator is a positive contraction, since it selects
   104	effects from the complete sandwich POVM. -/
   105	private theorem diagonalIndicator_bounds (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   106	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   107	    0 ≤ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ∧ diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   108	  obtain ⟨hpos, hsum⟩ := pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ
   109	  change (∀ bc : F × F, 0 ≤ Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) at hpos
   110	  change (∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2) = 1 at hsum
   111	  constructor
   112	  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun bc _ => by
   113	      split_ifs
   114	      · exact hpos bc
   115	      · exact le_refl 0
   116	  · calc
   117	      diagonalIndicator X Z α β a ≤
   118	          ∑ bc : F × F, Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2 := by
   119	        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun bc _ => ?_
   120	        split_ifs
   121	        · exact le_refl _
   122	        · exact hpos bc
   123	      _ = 1 := hsum

   125	/-- At the exceptional coefficient zero, completeness of Z leaves a
   126	coarse-grained X projection. This includes zero first coefficient. -/
   127	private theorem orderedIndicator_zero (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (α a : F) :
   128	    orderedIndicator X Z α 0 a = (X.postprocess (fun b => α * b)).effect a := by
   129	  unfold orderedIndicator
   130	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   131	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   132	  by_cases h : α * b = a
   133	  · simp only [zero_mul, add_zero, h, if_true]
   134	    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Z.sum_eq_one, mul_one]
   135	  · simp [h]

   137	/-- Every linear-answer ordered indicator is a contraction. For nonzero
   138	second coefficient this follows from the diagonal identity; at zero it
   139	follows from completeness and projective postprocessing. -/
   140	theorem orderedIndicator_gram_le_one (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   141	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (α β a : F) :
   142	    (orderedIndicator X Z α β a)ᴴ * orderedIndicator X Z α β a ≤ 1 := by
   143	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   144	  · subst β
   145	    rw [orderedIndicator_zero, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   146	      (SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective X hX (fun b => α * b) a).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   147	    exact measurement_effect_le_one _ _
   148	  · rw [orderedIndicator_gram_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ]
   149	    exact (diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a).2

   151	/-- The pointwise error in `eq:qld-g-prime` is supported on the zero second
   152	coefficient and bounded by the squared norm of the actual state vector. -/
   153	theorem abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   154	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   155	    (α β a : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   156	    |‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   157	        stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a)| ≤
   158	      if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0 := by
   159	  by_cases hβ : β = 0
   160	  · rw [if_pos hβ]
   161	    have hA0 := sq_nonneg ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖
   162	    have hA1 : ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z α β a) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   163	      rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, ← stateQForm_one ψ]
   164	      exact quadratic_form_mono (orderedIndicator_gram_le_one X Z hX hZ α β a) ψ
   165	    have hD := diagonalIndicator_bounds X Z hZ α β a
   166	    have hD0 := stateQForm_nonneg ψ hD.1
   167	    have hD1 : stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z α β a) ≤ ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   168	      rw [← stateQForm_one ψ]
   169	      exact quadratic_form_mono hD.2 ψ
   170	    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
   171	  · rw [if_neg hβ, orderedIndicator_norm_sq_of_ne_zero X Z hX α β a hβ ψ]
   172	    simp

   174	/-- Completeness and projectivity preserve total squared state mass. This is
   175	the normalization used after summing `eq:qld-g-prime` over polynomial labels. -/
   176	theorem sum_projective_state_norm_sq {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ]
   177	    (S : Quantum.Measurement Γ ι) (hS : Measurement.IsProjective S)
   178	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   179	    ∑ g : Γ, ‖applyOperatorToState (S.effect g) ψ‖ ^ 2 = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   180	  simp_rw [MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq, measurement_effect_hermitian,
   181	    fun g => (hS g).isIdempotentElem.eq]
   182	  change (∑ g : Γ, stateQForm ψ (S.effect g)) = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2
   183	  rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, S.sum_eq_one, stateQForm_one]
   184	
   185	/-- A polynomial not of the form `alpha * u + beta * v` has a nonzero
   186	coefficient outside those two monomials. Applied over the ring of base-point
   187	polynomials, this chooses one coefficient independently of both measurement
   188	outcomes in the argument following `eq:qld-g-prime`. -/
   189	private theorem exists_nonzero_nonlinear_coeff {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
   190	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R)
   191	    (hp : ¬ ∃ u v : R, p = MvPolynomial.C u * MvPolynomial.X 0 +
   192	      MvPolynomial.C v * MvPolynomial.X 1) :
   193	    ∃ e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, e ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 ∧ e ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 ∧
   194	      p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
   195	  classical

     4	/-!
     5	# Common exceptional fibers for polynomial coefficients
     6	
     7	A nonconstant polynomial in one block, with polynomial coefficients in a
     8	second block, has a nonzero coefficient at a nonconstant monomial. Its zero set controls
     9	all exceptional specializations simultaneously, independently of the outcome
    10	of a measurement. The weights may depend on the fixed block but not on the
    11	block being averaged.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1341-1358`,
    16	especially `eq:qld-g-2`; support for blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    17	-/

    30	private theorem exists_nonconstant_coeff {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}
    31	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r) :
    32	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
    33	  classical
    34	  by_contra! h
    35	  apply hp
    36	  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    37	  ext e
    38	  by_cases he : e = 0
    39	  · simp [he]
    40	  · simp [MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he, h e he]
    41	
    42	/-- A single coefficient defines the exceptional slices for every field
    43	outcome. Outside its zero set, every fiber has probability at most `D/q`;
    44	the exceptional set itself has probability at most `C/q`. Both degree
    45	conditions concern the displayed polynomial, not an assumed collision law.
    46	This is the common-set argument following `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting
    47	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    48	theorem exists_common_exceptional_coefficient {n k C D : ℕ}
    49	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    50	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    51	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D) :
    52	    ∃ e : Fin n →₀ ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ p.coeff e ≠ 0 ∧
    53	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F))
    54	        (fun z => if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    55	          (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F ∧
    56	      ∀ z : Fin k → F, MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) ≠ 0 → ∀ b : F,
    57	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    58	          (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    59	            then 1 else 0) ≤ (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F := by
    60	  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := exists_nonconstant_coeff p hp
    61	  refine ⟨e, he, hc, ?_, ?_⟩
    62	  · simpa using avg_eval_eq_le (p.coeff e) 0 hc (hcoeff e) (by simp)
    63	  · intro z hz b
    64	    have hne : MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p ≠ MvPolynomial.C b := by
    65	      intro h
    66	      apply hz
    67	      have h' := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff e) h
    68	      simpa [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_C, Ne.symm he] using h'
    69	    have hd : (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p).totalDegree ≤ D :=
    70	      (Finset.sup_mono (MvPolynomial.support_map_subset _ _)).trans hdegree
    71	    simpa using avg_eval_eq_le _ (MvPolynomial.C b) hne hd (by simp)
    72	
    73	/-- Summing all nonnegative outcome weights before averaging exceptional
    74	slices avoids an outcome-cardinality factor. The weights may depend on `z`
    75	and their sum is the same mass `M` at every `z`. This is the weighted fiber
    76	calculation in `eq:qld-g-2`, supporting blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    77	theorem avg_weighted_fiber_le {n k C D : ℕ}
    78	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
    79	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
    80	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
    81	    (w : (Fin k → F) → F → ℝ) (M : ℝ)
    82	    (hw : ∀ z b, 0 ≤ w z b) (hsum : ∀ z, ∑ b, w z b = M) :
    83	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
    84	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    85	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    86	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤ ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    87	  classical
    88	  obtain ⟨e, _, _, hbad, hgood⟩ :=
    89	    exists_common_exceptional_coefficient p hp hcoeff hdegree
    90	  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    91	    rw [← hsum (fun _ => 0)]
    92	    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => hw _ b
    93	  have hpoint (z : Fin k → F) :
    94	      (∑ b : F, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
    95	        (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
    96	          then 1 else 0) * w z b) ≤
    97	      (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
    98	        (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
    99	    by_cases hz : MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0
   100	    · simp only [hz, if_true, one_mul]
   101	      apply le_trans (b := M)
   102	      · rw [← hsum z]
   103	        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   104	        intro b _
   105	        apply le_trans (b := 1 * w z b)
   106	        · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw z b)
   107	          apply avgOver_uniform_le_const
   108	          intro x
   109	          split_ifs <;> norm_num
   110	        · rw [one_mul]
   111	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hM)
   112	    · simp only [hz, if_false, zero_mul, zero_add]
   113	      rw [← hsum z, Finset.mul_sum]
   114	      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
   115	        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hgood z hz b) (hw z b)
   116	  calc
   117	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   118	        (if MvPolynomial.eval z (p.coeff e) = 0 then 1 else 0) * M +
   119	          (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M) := avgOver_mono _ _ _ hpoint
   120	    _ ≤ (C : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M + (D : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * M := by
   121	      rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_mul_const, avgOver_uniform_const]
   122	      exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbad hM) le_rfl
   123	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring

   127	private theorem avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le
   128	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   129	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   130	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   131	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t))) ≤
   132	      (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   133	        stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) := by
   134	  classical
   135	  let w (bc : F × F) : ℝ := stateQForm ψ
   136	    (Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2)
   137	  have hw (bc : F × F) : 0 ≤ w bc :=
   138	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).1 bc)
   139	  have hsum : ∑ bc, w bc = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   140	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ, ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).2,
   141	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   142	    rfl
   143	  have hexpand (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   144	      stateQForm ψ (diagonalIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) =
   145	      ∑ bc : F × F, (if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t
   146	        then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   147	    rw [diagonalIndicator, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   148	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   149	    intro bc _
   150	    split_ifs <;> simp [w, stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
   151	  have hcollision (bc : F × F) :
   152	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   153	        if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
   154	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
   155	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   156	    exact affine_collision_average bc (r, t)
   157	  simp_rw [hexpand, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const, hcollision]
   158	  calc
   159	    _ ≤ ∑ bc : F × F, ((Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ +
   160	        if bc = (r, t) then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   161	      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   162	      intro bc _
   163	      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (hw bc)
   164	      split_ifs <;> simp
   165	    _ = _ := by
   166	      simp_rw [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   167	      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hsum]
   168	      simp [w]
   169	
   170	private theorem avg_orderedIndicator_linear_le
   171	    (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι) (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X)
   172	    (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z) (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   173	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   174	      ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1)
   175	        (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤
   176	      2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 + stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t) := by
   177	  have hexc : avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   178	      (fun v => if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) =
   179	        (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   180	    change avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F))
   181	      (fun v => if ((finTwoArrowEquiv F) v).2 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) = _
   182	    rw [avgOver_uniform_equiv (finTwoArrowEquiv F)]
   183	    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   184	    rw [avgOver_uniform_snd (fun β : F => if β = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0)]
   185	    simp [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
   186	  have hdrop : stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t * X.effect r * Z.effect t) ≤
   187	      stateQForm ψ (Z.effect t) := by
   188	    apply quadratic_form_mono
   189	    simpa only [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, measurement_effect_hermitian, mul_one,
   190	      (hZ t).isIdempotentElem.eq] using
   191	      star_left_conjugate_le_conjugate (measurement_effect_le_one X r) (Z.effect t)
   192	  have havg := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ (fun v =>
   193	    le_trans (le_abs_self _) (abs_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_sub_diagonal_le
   194	      X Z hX hZ (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t) ψ))
   195	  rw [avgOver_sub, hexc] at havg
   196	  have hdiag := avg_diagonalIndicator_linear_le X Z hZ r t ψ
   197	  linarith
   198	
   199	/-- The wrong-variable coefficient is concentrated only after the middle
   200	contraction has been removed. The outer measurement depends solely on the
   201	fixed block `z`; `X` depends solely on the varying block `x`. For the other
   202	class interchange `X,Z` and the two blocks. The vector is arbitrary and
   203	need not be normalized. This proves the local norm bound behind
   204	`eq:qld-g-prime-xpt-bound` and its reversed-order counterpart, supporting
   205	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   206	theorem avg_orderedIndicator_norm_sq_le_of_nonconstant {n k C D : ℕ}
   207	    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin k) F))
   208	    (hp : ¬ ∃ r, p = MvPolynomial.C r)
   209	    (hcoeff : ∀ e, (p.coeff e).totalDegree ≤ C) (hdegree : p.totalDegree ≤ D)
   210	    (r : (Fin n → F) → (Fin k → F) → F)
   211	    (X : (Fin n → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   212	    (Z : (Fin k → F) → Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   213	    (hX : ∀ x, Measurement.IsProjective (X x))
   214	    (hZ : ∀ z, Measurement.IsProjective (Z z)) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   215	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   216	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun x =>
   217	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   218	          ‖applyOperatorToState (orderedIndicator (X x) (Z z) (v 0) (v 1)
   219	            (v 0 * r x z + v 1 *
   220	              MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))) ψ‖ ^ 2))) ≤
   221	      ((C + D + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   222	  classical
   223	  let w (z : Fin k → F) (b : F) := stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect b)
   224	  have hsum (z : Fin k → F) : ∑ b, w z b = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   225	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, (Z z).sum_eq_one, stateQForm_one]
   226	  have hfiber := avg_weighted_fiber_le p hp hcoeff hdegree w (‖ψ‖ ^ 2)
   227	    (fun z b => stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((Z z).pos b)) hsum
   228	  have heval (z : Fin k → F) (x : Fin n → F) :
   229	      stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect
   230	        (MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))) =
   231	      ∑ b : F, (if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
   232	        then 1 else 0) * w z b := by
   233	    simp [w]
   234	  calc
   235	    _ ≤ avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z =>
   236	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F)) (fun x =>
   237	          2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   238	          stateQForm ψ ((Z z).effect
   239	            (MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p))))) := by
   240	      apply avgOver_mono
   241	      intro z
   242	      apply avgOver_mono
   243	      intro x
   244	      exact avg_orderedIndicator_linear_le (X x) (Z z) (hX x) (hZ z) _ _ ψ
   245	    _ = 2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   246	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin k → F)) (fun z => ∑ b : F,
   247	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin n → F))
   248	            (fun x => if MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.map (MvPolynomial.eval z) p) = b
   249	              then 1 else 0) * w z b) := by
   250	      simp_rw [heval, avgOver_add, avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_sum, avgOver_mul_const]
   251	    _ ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   252	        ((C + D : ℕ) : ℝ) / Fintype.card F * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := add_le_add le_rfl hfiber
   253	    _ = _ := by push_cast; ring
   254	
   255	end

     3	/-!
     4	# Ordered products selected by a global projective measurement
     5	
     6	The point comparison of a projective measurement can be refined to its original
     7	outcomes and composed with the two combined-point ordered-product estimates.
     8	All bounds are on the actual expanded state and retain the complete outcome sum.
     9	
    10	## References
    11	
    12	`eq:qld-g-42` and `eq:qld-g-43`, paper
    13	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1283-1300`.
    14	These are auxiliary estimates for issue #513, not the global-pair constructor.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    18	
    19	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    20	
    21	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    22	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
    23	
    24	noncomputable section
    25	
    26	/-- Projective refinement followed by two operator comparisons. If the evaluated
    27	measurement has consistency defect at most `eta` with `B`, and `B` is within
    28	`deltaSelf` of `A`, which is within `deltaOrder` of `T`, the full outcome sum
    29	for `R - R T` is at most `4 eta + 4 deltaSelf + 4 deltaOrder`.
    30	This is the quantitative insertion calculation in `eq:qld-g-42/43`; `T` need
    31	not be a measurement, so it applies to either ordered product. -/
    32	theorem projective_refinement_ordered_dist_le {X Γ α ι : Type*}
    33	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    34	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    35	    (μ : Distribution X) (R : Measurement Γ ι) (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R)
    36	    (ev : X → Γ → α) (A B : X → Measurement α ι) (T : X → α → Op ι)
    37	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (eta deltaSelf deltaOrder : ℝ)
    38	    (hpoint : consistencyDefect μ
    39	      (fun x a => (R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a) (fun x a => (B x).effect a) ψ ≤ eta)
    40	    (hself : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    41	      (fun x a => (A x).effect a) ψ ≤ deltaSelf)
    42	    (horder : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (A x).effect a) T ψ ≤ deltaOrder) :
    43	    opFamilyDistSq μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    44	      (fun x g => R.effect g * T x (ev x g)) ψ ≤
    45	        4 * eta + 4 * deltaSelf + 4 * deltaOrder := by
    46	  have hlift (U V : X → α → Op ι) :
    47	      opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x g => R.effect g * U x (ev x g))
    48	        (fun x g => R.effect g * V x (ev x g)) ψ ≤ opFamilyDistSq μ U V ψ := by
    49	    unfold opFamilyDistSq
    50	    apply avgOver_mono
    51	    intro x
    52	    simpa only [mul_sub] using sum_norm_mul_funIndexed_apply_le (ev x) R.effect
    53	      (fun a => U x a - V x a) ψ (measurement_sum_adjoint_mul_le_one R)
    54	  have hinsert : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    55	      (fun x g => R.effect g * (B x).effect (ev x g)) ψ ≤ 2 * eta := by
    56	    have h := hlift (fun x a => (R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a)
    57	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    58	    simp only [effect_mul_postprocess_effect_self R hR] at h
    59	    exact h.trans ((opFamilyDistSq_le_two_mul_consistencyDefect μ
    60	      (fun x => R.postprocess (ev x)) B ψ).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpoint
    61	        (by norm_num)))
    62	  have htail := (hlift (fun x a => (B x).effect a) T).trans
    63	    (opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le μ (fun x a => (B x).effect a)
    64	      (fun x a => (A x).effect a) T ψ deltaSelf deltaOrder hself horder)
    65	  have h := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le μ (fun _ g => R.effect g)
    66	    (fun x g => R.effect g * (B x).effect (ev x g))
    67	    (fun x g => R.effect g * T x (ev x g)) ψ (2 * eta)
    68	    (2 * deltaSelf + 2 * deltaOrder) hinsert htail
    69	  convert h using 1
    70	  ring
    71	
    72	namespace CombinedPointsWitness
    73	
    74	/-- Both ordered estimates `eq:qld-g-42/43` for a projective global measurement
    75	on any expanded block, compared to point operators on its opposite block.
    76	The readout `ev` may in particular be evaluation of an extended polynomial.
    77	The input `eta` is the actual rounded point-comparison error, not the unrounded
    78	low-degree error. The two losses of `deltaQ` come respectively from point
    79	self-consistency and the existing ordered-product approximation. No global-pair
    80	witness or concentration estimate is assumed. -/
    81	theorem ordered_dist_le {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε δQ : ℝ}
    82	    {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε} (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δQ)
    83	    {Γ : Type*} [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    84	    (p1 p2 : Placement) (hopposite : p1.IsOpposite p2)
    85	    (R : Measurement Γ (S.ExpandedLocalSpace p1.side))
    86	    (hR : Measurement.IsProjective R) (ev : ExtendedPointQuestion P → Γ → PauliScalar P)
    87	    (eta : ℝ)
    88	    (hpoint : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
    89	      (fun x a => S.place p1 ((R.postprocess (ev x)).effect a))
    90	      (fun x a => S.place p2
    91	        ((points.extendedQ p2.side x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2).effect a)) S.psiHat ≤ eta) :
    92	    (opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
    93	      (fun _ g => S.place p1 (R.effect g))
    94	      (fun x g => S.place p1 (R.effect g) * S.place p2
    95	        (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
    96	            x.2.1 * ab.1 + x.2.2 * ab.2 = ev x g),
    97	          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1 *
    98	            (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2)) S.psiHat ≤
    99	        4 * eta + 8 * δQ) ∧
   100	    (opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
   101	      (fun _ g => S.place p1 (R.effect g))
   102	      (fun x g => S.place p1 (R.effect g) * S.place p2
   103	        (∑ ab ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P =>
   104	            x.2.1 * ab.1 + x.2.2 * ab.2 = ev x g),
   105	          (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .Z x.1.2).effect ab.2 *
   106	            (S.pointMeasExp p2.side .X x.1.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat ≤
   107	        4 * eta + 8 * δQ) := by
   108	  classical
   109	  let A (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P) := S.placedMeasurement p1
   110	    (points.extendedQ p1.side x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2)
   111	  let B (x : ExtendedPointQuestion P) := S.placedMeasurement p2
   112	    (points.extendedQ p2.side x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2)
   113	  have hpoint' : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
   114	      (fun x a => ((S.placedMeasurement p1 R).postprocess (ev x)).effect a)
   115	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ eta := by
   116	    simpa only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
   117	      ProjectiveSetting.place_finsetSum, B] using hpoint
   118	  have hself : opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P))
   119	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a) (fun x a => (A x).effect a) S.psiHat ≤ δQ := by
   120	    rw [opFamilyDistSq_symm]
   121	    exact (extendedQ_spec points).2.1 p1 p2 hopposite
   122	  have hbound := projective_refinement_ordered_dist_le
   123	    (uniformDistribution (ExtendedPointQuestion P)) (S.placedMeasurement p1 R)
   124	    (S.placedMeasurement_isProjective p1 R hR) ev A B
   125	  constructor
   126	  · have h := hbound _ S.psiHat eta δQ δQ hpoint' hself
   127	      ((extendedQ_spec points).2.2.1 p1 p2 hopposite)
   128	    simpa only [ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
   129	      show 4 * eta + 4 * δQ + 4 * δQ = 4 * eta + 8 * δQ by ring] using h
   130	  · have h := hbound _ S.psiHat eta δQ δQ hpoint' hself
   131	      ((extendedQ_spec points).2.2.2 p1 p2 hopposite)
   132	    simpa only [ProjectiveSetting.placedMeasurement_effect,
   133	      show 4 * eta + 4 * δQ + 4 * δQ = 4 * eta + 8 * δQ by ring] using h
   134	
   135	end CombinedPointsWitness

     4	/-!
     5	# The ordered point product on a single placement
     6	
     7	The consistency guarantees carried by the joint point measurement compare it
     8	with the ordered `Z`-then-`X` product across a pair of opposite placements.
     9	The scalar estimates used to combine the two Pauli bases instead need the two
    10	families on one placement.  This module obtains that form by inserting the
    11	joint measurement on the opposite placement and applying the squared-distance
    12	triangle inequality twice.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	The statement is `lem:qld-4-10-same-placement` in
    17	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`; it restates the ordered
    18	`Z`-then-`X` display of `lem:qld-4-10`, paper
    19	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:689-709`.
    20	-/

    23	
    24	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT

    26	open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
    27	open MIPStarRE.Quantum

    31	/-- Every placement has an opposite placement, and the relation is symmetric
    32	between the two members of each pair. -/
    33	theorem Placement.exists_isOpposite (p : Placement) :
    34	    ∃ q : Placement, p.IsOpposite q ∧ q.IsOpposite p := by
    35	  cases p with
    36	  | AA' => exact ⟨.BA'', trivial, trivial⟩
    37	  | BA'' => exact ⟨.AA', trivial, trivial⟩
    38	  | BB' => exact ⟨.AB'', trivial, trivial⟩
    39	  | AB'' => exact ⟨.BB', trivial, trivial⟩
    40	
    41	/-- On a single placement, the joint point measurement is close to the ordered
    42	`Z`-then-`X` point product, with inflation factor four. -/
    43	theorem CombinedPointsWitness.orderedZX_dist_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
    44	    {ε δ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
    45	    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δ) (p : Placement) :
    46	    opFamilyDistSq
    47	        (uniformDistribution
    48	          ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
    49	        (fun xz ab => S.place p ((points.Q p.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
    50	        (fun xz ab => S.place p
    51	          ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
    52	            (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
    53	        S.psiHat ≤ 4 * δ := by
    54	  obtain ⟨q, hpq, hqp⟩ := p.exists_isOpposite
    55	  have htri := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le
    56	    (uniformDistribution
    57	      ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
    58	    (fun xz ab => S.place p ((points.Q p.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
    59	    (fun xz ab => S.place q ((points.Q q.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
    60	    (fun xz ab => S.place p
    61	      ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
    62	        (S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1))
    63	    S.psiHat δ δ (points.self_consistent p q hpq)
    64	    (points.consistent_ZX q p hqp)
    65	  linarith
    66	
    67	/-- On a single placement, the joint point measurement is close to the ordered
    68	`X`-then-`Z` point product, with the inflation factor four.  This is the
    69	same-placement form of the other ordered display of `lem:qld-4-10`, obtained
    70	from the self-consistency display in the same way. -/
    71	theorem CombinedPointsWitness.orderedXZ_dist_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
    72	    {ε δ : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P ε}
    73	    (points : CombinedPointsWitness S δ) (p : Placement) :
    74	    opFamilyDistSq
    75	        (uniformDistribution
    76	          ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
    77	        (fun xz ab => S.place p ((points.Q p.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
    78	        (fun xz ab => S.place p
    79	          ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
    80	            (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
    81	        S.psiHat ≤ 4 * δ := by
    82	  obtain ⟨q, hpq, hqp⟩ := p.exists_isOpposite
    83	  have htri := opFamilyDistSq_le_of_le_of_le
    84	    (uniformDistribution
    85	      ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P)))
    86	    (fun xz ab => S.place p ((points.Q p.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
    87	    (fun xz ab => S.place q ((points.Q q.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
    88	    (fun xz ab => S.place p
    89	      ((S.pointMeasExp p.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
    90	        (S.pointMeasExp p.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2))
    91	    S.psiHat δ δ (points.self_consistent p q hpq)
    92	    (points.consistent_XZ q p hqp)

     4	/-!
     5	# Restricting and completing global polynomial-pair measurements
     6	
     7	The combining map embeds pairs of bounded individual-degree polynomials into
     8	extended polynomials. Restricting a measurement along this embedding produces a
     9	submeasurement whose missing operator is the sum of the noncombined effects.
    10	Relabeling those effects by one specified pair completes the measurement and
    11	preserves projectivity.
    12	
    13	These algebraic constructions do not establish the concentration estimate
    14	`eq:qld-g-non-separable` or the point consistency required by
    15	`exists_globalPairWitness`; those are separate quantitative obligations.
    16	
    17	## References
    18	
    19	- Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.
    20	- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1375-1404`,
    21	  `eq:qld-sgg-completeness` and the final completion paragraph.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    25	
    26	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder
    27	
    28	noncomputable section
    29	
    30	/-- Recover the two polynomial components by setting the unused block to zero
    31	and the scalar coordinates to `(1,0)` or `(0,1)`. This algebraic substitution
    32	is the left inverse implicit in the restriction to combined outcomes in
    33	`eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. Unlike evaluation as a
    34	polynomial function on a finite field, it does not require a degree bound. -/
    35	noncomputable def recoverCombinedPair {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
    36	    (polynomial : MvPolynomial (Fin (2 * m + 2)) K) :
    37	    MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K :=
    38	  (MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun index =>
    39	    match finCombineEquiv m index with
    40	    | .inl (.inl coordinate) => MvPolynomial.X coordinate
    41	    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
    42	    | .inr scalar => if scalar = 0 then 1 else 0) polynomial,
    43	   MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C (fun index =>
    44	    match finCombineEquiv m index with
    45	    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
    46	    | .inl (.inr coordinate) => MvPolynomial.X coordinate
    47	    | .inr scalar => if scalar = 1 then 1 else 0) polynomial)
    48	
    49	/-- Substitution recovers both components of a combined polynomial. This is
    50	formalization support for the relabeling in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper
    51	lines 1375--1380. -/
    52	@[simp] theorem recoverCombinedPair_combinePoly {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ}
    53	    (first second : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K) :
    54	    recoverCombinedPair (combinePoly first second) = (first, second) := by
    55	  simp [recoverCombinedPair, combinePoly, MvPolynomial.eval₂_rename,
    56	    embX, embZ, alphaVar, betaVar, Function.comp_def, MvPolynomial.eval₂_eta]
    57	
    58	/-- Distinct polynomial pairs label distinct combined outcomes. This justifies
    59	restricting a measurement on extended polynomials to pairs without duplicating
    60	an effect in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. -/
    61	theorem combinePoly_injective {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {m : ℕ} :
    62	    Function.Injective (fun pair : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K =>
    63	      combinePoly pair.1 pair.2) := by
    64	  exact (show Function.LeftInverse recoverCombinedPair
    65	    (fun pair : MvPolynomial (Fin m) K × MvPolynomial (Fin m) K =>
    66	      combinePoly pair.1 pair.2) from fun pair =>
    67	        recoverCombinedPair_combinePoly pair.1 pair.2).injective
    68	
    69	/-- The bounded polynomial-pair embedding used to restrict the global
    70	measurement in `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. The degree
    71	bound is inherited from `def:combine-map`; the two scalar coordinates have
    72	degree one, allowed by admissibility. -/
    73	noncomputable def combinedPolyEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams) :
    74	    PolyPair P ↪ MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d where
    75	  toFun pair := ⟨combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1,
    76	    combinePoly_mem_polyFunc P.hd pair.1.2 pair.2.2⟩
    77	  inj' := by
    78	    intro first second heq
    79	    have hpoly : combinePoly first.1.1 first.2.1 = combinePoly second.1.1 second.2.1 :=
    80	      congrArg Subtype.val heq
    81	    have hpair : (first.1.1, first.2.1) = (second.1.1, second.2.1) :=
    82	      combinePoly_injective hpoly
    83	    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst hpair))
    84	      (Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.snd hpair))
    85	
    86	/-- Evaluation of a combined outcome is the affine combination of its two
    87	components.  This is the pointwise algebraic identity used when transferring
    88	the global-pair measurement to the expanded point measurements in
    89	`lem:qld-4-7`, paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1364--1380`.
    90	It is a formalization-only consequence of `def:combine-map`; it does not assert
    91	any consistency or quantitative error estimate.
    92	-/
    93	theorem combinedPolyEmbedding_eval (P : AdmissibleParams)
    94	    (u : Fin (2 * P.m + 2) → PauliScalar P) (pair : PolyPair P) :
    95	    MvPolynomial.eval u (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair).1 =
    96	      u (alphaVar P.m) * evalAt .X (projX u) pair +
    97	        u (betaVar P.m) * evalAt .Z (projZ u) pair := by
    98	  change MvPolynomial.eval u (combinePoly pair.1.1 pair.2.1) = _
    99	  rw [combinePoly_eval]
   100	  rfl
   101	
   102	/-- Restrict an extended-polynomial measurement to combined outcomes, as in
   103	`eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. Injectivity of the combining
   104	map ensures that the retained effects sum to at most the identity. This
   105	construction does not assert the source's quantitative completeness bound. -/
   106	noncomputable def combinedPairSubmeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams)
   107	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   108	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   109	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier) :
   110	    Quantum.Submeasurement (PolyPair P) carrier where
   111	  effect pair := measurement.effect (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)
   112	  pos pair := measurement.pos _
   113	  sum_le_one := by
   114	    classical
   115	    rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
   116	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
   117	    exact (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
   118	      (fun outcome _ _ => measurement.pos outcome)).trans measurement.sum_le_one
   119	
   120	/-- Restricting to combined outcomes preserves projectivity, as asserted
   121	before `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380. -/
   122	theorem combinedPairSubmeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams)
   123	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   124	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   125	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   126	    (hprojective : Measurement.IsProjective measurement) :
   127	    ∀ pair, Quantum.IsProj ((combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair) := by
   128	  intro pair
   129	  exact hprojective (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)
   130	
   131	/-- The missing operator of the polynomial-pair submeasurement is exactly the
   132	sum of the effects outside the range of the combining map. This is the
   133	operator identity underlying `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`, paper lines 1375--1380;
   134	the bound on its state mass is a separate obligation. -/
   135	theorem combinedPairSubmeasurement_missing (P : AdmissibleParams)
   136	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   137	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   138	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier) :
   139	    1 - (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total =
   140	      ∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   141	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   142	        measurement.effect polynomial := by
   143	  classical
   144	  have htotal : (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total =
   145	      ∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   146	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   147	        measurement.effect polynomial := by
   148	    change (∑ pair, measurement.effect (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair)) = _
   149	    rw [← Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
   150	      (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
   151	    congr 1
   152	    ext polynomial
   153	    simp
   154	  rw [htotal, ← measurement.sum_eq_one]
   155	  apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr
   156	  exact (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
   157	    (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P))
   158	    measurement.effect).symm.trans (add_comm _ _)
   159	
   160	/-- Relabel a combined polynomial by its unique pair and send every other
   161	polynomial to a specified pair. This implements the completion at an arbitrary
   162	outcome in the last paragraph of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404. The
   163	noncombined outcomes are retained at the completion outcome, not discarded. -/
   164	noncomputable def completedPairLabel (P : AdmissibleParams) (completionPair : PolyPair P) :
   165	    MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d → PolyPair P :=
   166	  Function.extend (combinedPolyEmbedding P) id (fun _ => completionPair)
   167	
   168	/-- Completion preserves every combined polynomial's pair label. -/
   169	@[simp] theorem completedPairLabel_combinedPolyEmbedding (P : AdmissibleParams)
   170	    (completionPair pair : PolyPair P) :
   171	    completedPairLabel P completionPair (combinedPolyEmbedding P pair) = pair := by
   172	  exact (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective.extend_apply _ _ _
   173	
   174	/-- All outcomes outside the combining map's range go to the completion pair. -/
   175	theorem completedPairLabel_of_not_mem_range (P : AdmissibleParams)
   176	    (completionPair : PolyPair P)
   177	    (polynomial : MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d)
   178	    (houtside : polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)) :
   179	    completedPairLabel P completionPair polynomial = completionPair := by
   180	  exact Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ houtside
   181	
   182	/-- The completed polynomial-pair measurement of the final paragraph of
   183	`lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404, obtained by relabeling all extended
   184	polynomial outcomes. No assertion about consistency is built into this
   185	construction. -/
   186	noncomputable def completedPairMeasurement (P : AdmissibleParams)
   187	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   188	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   189	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   190	    (completionPair : PolyPair P) : Quantum.Measurement (PolyPair P) carrier :=
   191	  measurement.postprocess (completedPairLabel P completionPair)
   192	
   193	/-- Completing the pair measurement adds precisely its missing operator to
   194	the specified outcome and leaves all other effects unchanged. This is the
   195	completion formula of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404. -/
   196	theorem completedPairMeasurement_effect (P : AdmissibleParams)
   197	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   198	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   199	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   200	    (completionPair pair : PolyPair P) :
   201	    (completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair).effect pair =
   202	      (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair +
   203	        if pair = completionPair then 1 - (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total
   204	        else 0 := by
   205	  classical
   206	  rw [completedPairMeasurement, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   207	  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Finset.univ
   208	    (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P))]
   209	  have hgood :
   210	      Finset.univ.filter (fun polynomial => polynomial ∈ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)) =
   211	        Finset.univ.image (combinedPolyEmbedding P) := by
   212	    ext polynomial
   213	    simp
   214	  rw [hgood, Finset.sum_image (fun first _ second _ heq =>
   215	    (combinedPolyEmbedding P).injective heq)]
   216	  simp only [completedPairLabel_combinedPolyEmbedding]
   217	  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ pair)]
   218	  congr 1
   219	  have hbad :
   220	      (∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   221	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   222	        if completedPairLabel P completionPair polynomial = pair then
   223	          measurement.effect polynomial else 0) =
   224	      ∑ polynomial ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   225	        (fun polynomial => polynomial ∉ Set.range (combinedPolyEmbedding P)),
   226	        if completionPair = pair then measurement.effect polynomial else 0 := by
   227	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   228	    intro polynomial hpolynomial
   229	    rw [completedPairLabel_of_not_mem_range P completionPair polynomial
   230	      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpolynomial).2]
   231	  rw [hbad]
   232	  by_cases heq : pair = completionPair
   233	  · simp [heq, combinedPairSubmeasurement_missing]
   234	  · simp [heq, Ne.symm heq]
   235	
   236	/-- The completed polynomial-pair measurement is projective whenever the
   237	extended-polynomial measurement is projective. This proves the qualitative
   238	completion step in `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404, without assuming its
   239	unproved consistency conclusion. -/
   240	theorem completedPairMeasurement_projective (P : AdmissibleParams)
   241	    {carrier : Type*} [Fintype carrier] [DecidableEq carrier]
   242	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   243	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) carrier)
   244	    (hprojective : Measurement.IsProjective measurement) (completionPair : PolyPair P) :
   245	    Measurement.IsProjective (completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair) := by
   246	  exact SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective measurement hprojective _
   247	
   248	open MIPStarRE.Quantum DistanceCalculus
   249	
   250	/-- Completion can only increase agreement with any evaluated reference
   251	measurement on the opposite tensor factor. Consequently, its consistency
   252	defect is at most the squared state norm minus the retained diagonal overlap.
   253	This is the completion step of `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404, for an
   254	arbitrary outcome evaluation; it does not supply the preceding overlap bound.
   255	Neither projectivity nor normalization of the state is needed. -/
   256	theorem completedPairMeasurement_evaluated_defect_le (P : AdmissibleParams)
   257	    {Answer Left Right : Type*} [Fintype Answer] [DecidableEq Answer]
   258	    [Fintype Left] [DecidableEq Left] [Fintype Right] [DecidableEq Right]
   259	    (measurement : Quantum.Measurement
   260	      (MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries.polyFunc (2 * P.m + 2) (PauliScalar P) P.d) Left)
   261	    (completionPair : PolyPair P) (eval : PolyPair P → Answer)
   262	    (reference : Quantum.Measurement Answer Right)
   263	    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Left × Right)) :
   264	    (∑ a : Answer, ∑ b : Answer, if a = b then 0 else
   265	      stateQForm psi (heteroKron
   266	        (((completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair).postprocess eval).effect a)
   267	        (reference.effect b))) ≤
   268	      ‖psi‖ ^ 2 - ∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm psi
   269	        (heteroKron ((combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair)
   270	          (reference.effect (eval pair))) := by
   271	  classical
   272	  let completed := completedPairMeasurement P measurement completionPair
   273	  have hdiag :
   274	      (∑ a : Answer, stateQForm psi
   275	        (heteroKron ((completed.postprocess eval).effect a) (reference.effect a))) =
   276	        ∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm psi
   277	          (heteroKron (completed.effect pair) (reference.effect (eval pair))) := by
   278	    simp_rw [Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, heteroKron_finset_sum_left,
   279	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   280	    calc
   281	      _ = ∑ a : Answer, ∑ pair ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun pair => eval pair = a),
   282	          stateQForm psi
   283	            (heteroKron (completed.effect pair) (reference.effect (eval pair))) := by
   284	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   285	        intro a _
   286	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   287	        intro pair hpair
   288	        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2]
   289	      _ = _ := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ eval _
   290	  have hretained :
   291	      (∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm psi
   292	        (heteroKron ((combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).effect pair)
   293	          (reference.effect (eval pair)))) ≤
   294	        ∑ pair : PolyPair P, stateQForm psi
   295	          (heteroKron (completed.effect pair) (reference.effect (eval pair))) := by
   296	    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
   297	    intro pair _
   298	    dsimp [completed]
   299	    rw [completedPairMeasurement_effect]
   300	    by_cases hpair : pair = completionPair
   301	    · rw [if_pos hpair, heteroKron_add_left, stateQForm_add]
   302	      exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (stateQForm_nonneg psi
   303	        (kronecker_nonneg
   304	          (sub_nonneg.mpr (combinedPairSubmeasurement P measurement).total_le_one)
   305	          (reference.pos (eval pair))))
   306	    · simp [hpair]
   307	  have hdefect := point_defect_eq
   308	    (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := Right) (completed.postprocess eval))
   309	    (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := Left) reference) psi
   310	  simp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
   311	    Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] at hdefect
   312	  simp_rw [placed_product_stateQForm_eq] at hdefect
   313	  change _ ≤ _
   314	  rw [hdefect, hdiag]
   315	  exact sub_le_sub_left hretained _
   316	
   317	/-- Uniformly averaging the completion estimate gives the consistency defect
   318	needed for the point marginals in `lem:qld-4-7`, paper lines 1402--1404.
   319	The retained overlap remains explicit and must be bounded from the source
   320	strategy before this estimate can establish global-pair existence. -/
   321	theorem completedPairMeasurement_consistencyDefect_le (P : AdmissibleParams)
   322	    {Question Answer Left Right : Type*}
   323	    [Fintype Question] [DecidableEq Question] [Nonempty Question]

    13	`eq:qld-s-good-and-bad` through `eq:qld-sgg-mhat-sandwich`;
    14	blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`.

    83	/-- The wrong outer projection of a scalar-linear ordered product has
    84	average squared norm at most `2/q` times the actual vector mass. One `1/q`

    89	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
    90	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
    91	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
    92	      ‖applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) *
    93	        orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) ≤
    94	      2 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
    95	  classical
    96	  let w (bc : F × F) := stateQForm ψ
    97	    (Z.effect bc.2 * X.effect bc.1 * Z.effect bc.2)
    98	  have hw (bc : F × F) : 0 ≤ w bc :=
    99	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ ((pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).1 bc)
   100	  have hsum : ∑ bc, w bc = ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   101	    rw [← stateQForm_one ψ, ← (pastedMeasurement_isMeasurement X Z hZ).2,
   102	      stateQForm_finset_sum]
   103	    rfl
   104	  have hpoint (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   105	      ‖applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) *
   106	        orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   107	      (if v 1 = 0 then ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 else 0) + ∑ bc : F × F,
   108	        (if v 0 * bc.1 + v 1 * bc.2 = v 0 * r + v 1 * t ∧ bc.1 ≠ r
   109	          then 1 else 0) * w bc := by
   110	    by_cases hv : v 1 = 0
   111	    · rw [if_pos hv]
   112	      apply le_trans (b := ‖ψ‖ ^ 2)
   113	      · apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
   114	        rw [applyOperatorToState_mul]

   116	          (MagicSquareRigidity.conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (hX r).one_sub) _).trans
   117	          (MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le
   118	            (orderedIndicator_gram_le_one X Z hX hZ _ _ _) ψ)
   119	      · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun bc _ =>
   120	          mul_nonneg (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (hw bc))
   121	    · rw [if_neg hv, zero_add, MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_sq]
   122	      change stateQForm ψ _ ≤ _
   123	      rw [wrong_ordered_gram X Z hX r _ _ _ hv, stateQForm_finset_sum]

   126	      intro bc _

   159	theorem point_mismatch_le_ordered_error (X Z : Quantum.Measurement F ι)
   160	    (hX : Measurement.IsProjective X) (hZ : Measurement.IsProjective Z)
   161	    (r t : F) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   162	    ‖applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   163	      2 * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) (fun v =>
   164	        ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState
   165	          (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2) +
   166	      4 * (Fintype.card F : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   167	  have hpoint (v : Fin 2 → F) :
   168	      ‖applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) ψ‖ ^ 2 ≤
   169	        2 * ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState
   170	          (orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2 +
   171	        2 * ‖applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) *
   172	          orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)) ψ‖ ^ 2 := by
   173	    let T := orderedIndicator X Z (v 0) (v 1) (v 0 * r + v 1 * t)
   174	    have h := sum_mass_le_residual_add_image (Finset.univ : Finset Unit)
   175	      (fun _ => applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) ψ)
   176	      (fun _ => applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) * T) ψ)
   177	    simp only [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton] at h

   180	          applyOperatorToState ((1 - X.effect r) * T) ψ‖ ≤
   181	        ‖ψ - applyOperatorToState T ψ‖ := by
   182	      rw [applyOperatorToState_mul]
   183	      have heq : applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) ψ -
   184	          applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) (applyOperatorToState T ψ) =
   185	          applyOperatorToState (1 - X.effect r) (ψ - applyOperatorToState T ψ) := by
   186	        simp only [applyOperatorToState, map_sub]
   187	      rw [heq]
   188	      exact MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le
   189	        (MagicSquareRigidity.conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (hX r).one_sub) _

   191	      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hcontract 2)

   193	  have h := avgOver_mono (uniformDistribution (Fin 2 → F)) _ _ hpoint
   194	  simp only [avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_add, avgOver_const_mul] at h
   195	  have hm := avg_wrong_ordered_norm_sq_le X Z hX hZ r t ψ

     4	/-!
     5	# Pauli basis test soundness interface
     6	
     7	This module contains the quantitative error function and the closed definitions
     8	used to state Pauli basis test soundness.  The carriers are concrete
     9	finite-dimensional vectors and matrices so that the soundness proof can use the
    10	existing Hilbert-space API without introducing a dependency cycle.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	The interface supports blueprint
    15	`thm:pauli`, with paper origin
    16	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:1426-1447`.
    17	The distance functionals use blueprint `def:state-distance` and
    18	`def:povm-distance`.
    19	-/

   365	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (first second : Placement)

   410	            (linePointDist P.toLdParams))
   411	          (fun sample answer => S.place p1
   412	            (((S.combinedLineMeasurement p1.side sample.1.1 sample.2.1).postprocess

   417	              (some ab.1, some ab.2)).effect answer))

   422	  obtain ⟨lineError, hlineError, hscalar⟩ :=
   423	    exists_conditioned_polynomial_bound deltaQ hdeltaQ constant hconstant pastingError hpasting

   426	  have hreverse : second.IsOpposite first := by

   452	            evalOpt sample.2.1 sample.2.2 polys.2))).effect answer)) setting.psiHat ≤ 1 := by

    39	/-- The sum of the seven potentially rejecting branches of the supplied
    40	strategy is bounded by the scalar expression used by the direct passing-error
    41	envelope. -/
    42	theorem seven_branch_rejections_le
    43	    (lines : ExtendedLinesWitness setting points deltaL) :
    44	    directLdBranchRejectionProbability P.extendedDirectLd (strategy lines)
    45	          (.point, .point) +
    46	        directLdBranchRejectionProbability P.extendedDirectLd (strategy lines)
    47	          (.point, .aline) +
    48	        directLdBranchRejectionProbability P.extendedDirectLd (strategy lines)
    49	          (.point, .dline) +
    50	        directLdBranchRejectionProbability P.extendedDirectLd (strategy lines)
    51	          (.aline, .point) +
    52	        directLdBranchRejectionProbability P.extendedDirectLd (strategy lines)
    53	          (.aline, .aline) +
    54	        directLdBranchRejectionProbability P.extendedDirectLd (strategy lines)
    55	          (.dline, .point) +
    56	        directLdBranchRejectionProbability P.extendedDirectLd (strategy lines)
    57	          (.dline, .dline) ≤
    58	      deltaQ + 16 * deltaL + 4 * Real.sqrt (deltaQ + 2 * deltaL) +
    59	        5 * ((P.m * P.d : Real) / (P.q : Real)) := by
    60	  have hpoint := point_point_rejection_le lines
    61	  have hmixed := mixed_line_point_rejections_le_four_mul lines
    62	  have haxis :=
    63	    aline_aline_rejection_le_axisParameterEvaluatedCoefficientDefect_add lines
    64	  have hdiagonal :=

    66	  rw [axis_parameter_evaluated_coefficient_defect_eq] at haxis
    67	  rw [diagonal_parameter_evaluated_coefficient_defect_eq] at hdiagonal
    68	  have haxisEval := axis_parameter_evaluation_defect_le lines
    69	  have hdiagonalEval := diagonal_parameter_evaluation_defect_le lines

    72	          (P.extendedDirectLd.m * P.extendedDirectLd.d : Real) /
    73	            (P.extendedDirectLd.q : Real) ≤
    74	        5 * ((P.m * P.d : Real) / (P.q : Real)) := by

    77	            (P.extendedDirectLd.m * P.extendedDirectLd.d : Real)) /

     6	
     7	The six-register state of `eq:def-psihat` factors as the two-player state
     8	`ExtendedLineGame.pairState` and an unused normalized EPR pair, for each of
     9	the opposite register placements `AA'`--`BA''` and `AB''`--`BB'`. Therefore
    10	arbitrary Hermitian operators on the expanded local spaces have the same
    11	correlation in the two descriptions. An individual operator need not factor
    12	between its strategy register and its Pauli register.

    14	These are formalization-only auxiliary identities for the strategy construction
    15	in the proof of `lem:qld-4-7`. They do not establish its passing value or the
    16	existence of its input measurements. Parent issue #119 remains open.

    65	theorem exists_combinedPoints_conditioned_line_marginal_defect_le :

    67	      ∀ (P : AdmissibleParams) (ε δQ : ℝ) (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)

    71	          (fun question answer => S.place p1
    72	            ((((points.Q p1.side question.2.2 question.1.2.2).postprocess
    73	              (fun pair => (some pair.2, some pair.1))).postprocess Prod.fst).effect answer))
    74	          (fun question answer => S.place p2
    75	            ((S.lineEvalMeasExp p2.side .Z question.1.1.2 question.1.2.2).effect answer))

    95	          (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).postprocess Prod.snd).effect answer ∧
    96	      (((points.Q side pointX pointZ).postprocess
    97	        (fun pair => (some pair.2, some pair.1))).postprocess Prod.snd).effect answer =

    99	          (fun pair => (some pair.1, some pair.2))).postprocess Prod.fst).effect answer := by

    20	theorem dLinePointDist_zero_direction_mass_le (L : LdParams) :
    21	    avgOver (dLinePointDist L) (fun sample =>
    22	      if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    23	      1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) := by
    24	  classical
    25	  let last : Fin L.m := ⟨L.m - 1, by have := L.hm; omega⟩
    26	  let coord : LdIndex L := .inr last
    27	  have hmap : (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map (fun raw => raw coord) =
    28	      uniformDistribution (ScalarQ L) := by
    29	    change (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map
    30	      (fun raw => (Equiv.funSplitAt coord (ScalarQ L) raw).1) = _
    31	    rw [← Distribution.map_map, uniformDistribution_map_equiv,
    32	      uniformDistribution_map_fst]
    33	  have hzero : avgOver (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
    34	      (fun raw => if raw coord = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
    35	      1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L) := by
    36	    rw [← Distribution.avgOver_map (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L))
    37	      (fun raw => raw coord) (fun value => if value = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0), hmap]
    38	    simp [avgOver, uniformDistribution_weight_apply, mul_ite]
    39	  unfold dLinePointDist clDistribution
    40	  rw [Distribution.avgOver_map, Distribution.avgOver_map]
    41	  refine le_trans (avgOver_mono _ _ _ ?_) hzero.le
    42	  intro raw
    43	  dsimp only
    44	  rw [dLineDescOf_ldDLineCL]
    45	  split_ifs with hdir hcoord hcoord
    46	  · exact le_rfl
    47	  · exfalso
    48	    apply hcoord
    49	    have hlast := congrFun hdir last
    50	    change prefixProjection (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed raw))
    51	      (LdSpace.direction raw) last = 0 at hlast
    52	    have hindex : ¬ last.val < (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed raw)).val := by
    53	      have := (chiIndex L (LdSpace.seed raw)).isLt
    54	      dsimp [last]
    55	      omega
    56	    simpa [prefixProjection, hindex, LdSpace.direction, coord] using hlast

    58	  · exact le_rfl

    63	`def:line-point-dist`, paper `08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`,
    64	including its degenerate fibers. -/

    67	      if sample.1.direction = 0 then 1 else 0) ≤
    68	      1 / (2 * Fintype.card (ScalarQ L)) := by

    74	    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / Fintype.card (ScalarQ L)) :=

    27	/-- A positive atom gives a positive atom of every push-forward. -/
    28	private theorem map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos {Source Target : Type*}
    29	    [DecidableEq Target] (law : Distribution Source) (mapping : Source → Target)
    30	    (sample : Source) (hpositive : 0 < law.weight sample) :
    31	    0 < (law.map mapping).weight (mapping sample) := by
    32	  classical
    33	  have hmem : sample ∈ law.support := by
    34	    by_contra hnot
    35	    simp [law.outsideSupport sample hnot] at hpositive
    36	  exact hpositive.trans_le (Finset.single_le_sum
    37	    (fun other _ => law.nonnegative other) (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, rfl⟩))

    39	/-- Every canonical direct line has positive marginal mass. In particular, the
    40	conditional distribution in the construction at paper lines 1118--1132 is defined
    41	on every direct line, including zero-direction diagonal lines. -/
    42	theorem directLinePointDist_line_weight_pos (params : DirectLdParams)
    43	    (line : DirectLineDesc params) :
    44	    0 < ((directLinePointDist params).map Prod.fst).weight line := by
    45	  have huniform (sample : DirectLdSpace params) :
    46	      0 < (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params)).weight sample := by
    47	    rw [uniformDistribution_weight_apply]
    48	    positivity
    49	  suffices hpoint : 0 < (directLinePointDist params).weight (line, line.base) by
    50	    exact map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos _ Prod.fst _ hpoint
    51	  cases line with
    52	  | axis base index baseFixed =>
    53	    let sample : DirectLdSpace params := ⟨base, index, 0⟩
    54	    have haxis := map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos
    55	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params))
    56	      (fun source => (directALineDescOf params source, source.point)) sample (huniform sample)
    57	    have hdecode : directALineDescOf params sample = .axis base index baseFixed := by
    58	      simp [directALineDescOf, sample, baseFixed]
    59	    change 0 < (directALinePointDist params).weight _ at haxis
    60	    rw [hdecode] at haxis
    61	    have hother := (directDLinePointDist params).nonnegative
    62	      (DirectLineDesc.axis base index baseFixed, base)
    63	    change 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (directALinePointDist params).weight _ +
    64	      (1 - 1 / 2) * (directDLinePointDist params).weight _
    65	    change 0 < (directALinePointDist params).weight
    66	      (DirectLineDesc.axis base index baseFixed, base) at haxis
    67	    dsimp only [DirectLineDesc.base]
    68	    linarith
    69	  | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero =>
    70	    let sample : DirectLdSpace params := ⟨base, index, direction⟩
    71	    have hprefix : directPrefixProjection index direction = direction := by
    72	      funext coordinate
    73	      simp only [directPrefixProjection]
    74	      split_ifs with hbefore
    75	      · exact (prefixZero coordinate hbefore).symm
    76	      · rfl
    77	    have hdiagonal := map_weight_pos_of_weight_pos
    78	      (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace params))
    79	      (fun source => (directDLineDescOf params source, source.point)) sample (huniform sample)
    80	    have hdecode : directDLineDescOf params sample =
    81	        .diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero := by
    82	      simp [directDLineDescOf, sample, hprefix, baseFixed]
    83	    change 0 < (directDLinePointDist params).weight _ at hdiagonal
    84	    rw [hdecode] at hdiagonal
    85	    have hother := (directALinePointDist params).nonnegative
    86	      (DirectLineDesc.diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero, base)
    87	    change 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (directALinePointDist params).weight _ +
    88	      (1 - 1 / 2) * (directDLinePointDist params).weight _
    89	    change 0 < (directDLinePointDist params).weight
    90	      (DirectLineDesc.diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero, base) at hdiagonal
    91	    dsimp only [DirectLineDesc.base]
    92	    linarith

   107	/-- The genuine conditional law of the supported subline triples given their
   108	extended line, as in paper lines 1118--1132. There is no zero-mass branch. -/
   109	def SubLineWitness.conditionalLaw {params : AdmissibleParams}
   110	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (line : DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd) :
   111	    Distribution (sublines.Fiber line) where
   112	  support := Finset.univ
   113	  weight sample := sublines.D.weight sample.val / (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line
   114	  nonnegative sample := div_nonneg (sublines.D.nonnegative sample.val)
   115	    (sublines.fiber_mass_pos line).le
   116	  outsideSupport sample hnot := (hnot (Finset.mem_univ sample)).elim

   123	    sublines.D.weight sample.val / (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line) = 1
   124	  rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_coe_sort]

   171	/-- The directly indexed form of the extended-line POVM at paper lines
   172	1118--1132: condition the subline law and average the postprocessed paired-line POVMs. -/
   173	def SubLineWitness.extendedMeasurement {params : AdmissibleParams}
   174	    {error pointError lineError : ℝ} {setting : ProjectiveSetting params error}
   175	    {points : CombinedPointsWitness setting pointError}
   176	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (lines : CombinedLinesWitness setting points lineError)
   177	    (side : PlayerSide) (line : DirectLineDesc params.extendedDirectLd) :
   178	    Quantum.Measurement (DirectDegPoly params.extendedDirectLd (params.m * params.d + 1))
   179	      (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace side) := by
   180	  let family (sample : sublines.Fiber line) :=
   181	    (lines.T side sample.val.2.1 sample.val.2.2).postprocess
   182	      (sublines.combinedPolynomial sample.val (Finset.mem_filter.mp sample.property).1)
   183	  have hsum : (∑ polynomial, averageOperatorOverDistribution (sublines.conditionalLaw line)
   184	      (fun sample => (family sample).effect polynomial)) = 1 := by
   185	    rw [← averageOperatorOverDistribution_sum]
   186	    simp only [Quantum.Measurement.sum_eq_one]
   187	    exact averageOperatorOverDistribution_const_of_isProbability _
   188	      (sublines.conditionalLaw_isProbability line) 1
   189	  exact { effect := fun polynomial => averageOperatorOverDistribution
   190	            (sublines.conditionalLaw line) (fun sample => (family sample).effect polynomial)
   191	          pos := fun polynomial => averageOperatorOverDistribution_nonneg _ _
   192	            (fun sample => (family sample).pos polynomial)
   193	          sum_le_one := le_of_eq hsum
   194	          sum_eq_one := hsum }

   196	/-- Integrating the conditional law recovers the original subline law.
   197	This is finite disintegration, not an independence assertion about projections. -/
   198	theorem SubLineWitness.avgOver_conditionalLaw {params : AdmissibleParams}
   199	    (sublines : SubLineWitness params) (quantity : SubLineTriple params → ℝ) :
   200	    avgOver (sublines.D.map Prod.fst) (fun line =>
   201	      avgOver (sublines.conditionalLaw line) (fun sample => quantity sample.val)) =
   202	        avgOver sublines.D quantity := by
   203	  classical
   204	  simp only [avgOver, SubLineWitness.conditionalLaw]
   205	  calc
   206	    (∑ line ∈ (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).support,
   207	        (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line *
   208	          ∑ sample : sublines.Fiber line,
   209	            (sublines.D.weight sample.val / (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).weight line) *
   210	              quantity sample.val) =
   211	        ∑ line ∈ (sublines.D.map Prod.fst).support,
   212	          ∑ sample ∈ sublines.D.support.filter (fun sample => sample.1 = line),
   213	            sublines.D.weight sample * quantity sample := by
   214	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   215	      intro line _
   216	      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   217	      trans ∑ sample : sublines.Fiber line, sublines.D.weight sample.val * quantity sample.val
   218	      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   219	        intro sample _
   220	        field_simp [(sublines.fiber_mass_pos line).ne']
   221	        exact (div_eq_iff (sublines.fiber_mass_pos line).ne').mpr (by ring)
   222	      · exact Finset.sum_coe_sort
   223	          (sublines.D.support.filter (fun sample => sample.1 = line))
   224	          (fun sample => sublines.D.weight sample * quantity sample)

   226	      exact Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
   227	        (fun sample hsample => Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨sample, hsample, rfl⟩) _
